SELECT t.task_type AS typeName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM check_task t WHERE t.deleted = 0
AND t.create_time BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME(#{reqVO.startTime}) AND FROM_UNIXTIME(#{reqVO.endTime})
AND t.area_id = #{reqVO.areaId}
GROUP BY t.task_type

SELECT DATE(t.dispatch_time) AS date, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, t.dispatch_time, t.finish_time) / 24) AS duration FROM check_task t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.status = '已完成'
AND t.dispatch_time BETWEEN FROM_UNIXTIME(#{reqVO.startTime}) AND FROM_UNIXTIME(#{reqVO.endTime})
AND t.area_id = #{reqVO.areaId}
GROUP BY DATE(t.dispatch_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT t.id AS id, t.task_type AS taskType, t.dispatch_time AS dispatchTime, t.deadline_time AS deadlineTime, t.status AS status, a.name AS areaName, u.nickname AS executeUserName, t.finish_time AS finishTime, t.task_progress AS taskProgress, t.transfer_reason AS transferReason, t.remark AS remark, t.reserve1 AS reserve1, t.reserve2 AS reserve2, t.creator AS creator, t.updater AS updater, t.create_time AS createTime, t.update_time AS updateTime FROM check_task t LEFT JOIN area_info a ON t.area_id = a.id AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user_info u ON t.execute_user_id = u.id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.deleted = 0
